correctness.rationale: The graph automorphism group is exactly \(S_n\): degrees identify singleton vertices and singleton nonadjacency reconstructs every support. Pointwise stabilizers of a selected family are precisely permutations inside equal coordinate-signature classes, so determining is equivalent to injectivity of the signature map. This gives the sharp \(\lceil\log_2 n\rceil\) bound and the injection count. The packaged checker exhaustively verifies all minimum families for \(2\le n\le7\).
